title: How a product is made
intro: From the first drawing to the finished part - every stage happens under one roof.

steps.name: Drawing & costing
steps.description: Customer sends a drawing, a sample or an idea. We study the part, suggest changes where needed and give the costing.

steps.name: 3D design & mould design
steps.description: The product is modelled in 3D, then the mould is designed around it - cavity layout, cooling, ejection and gating.

steps.name: 3D printed prototype
steps.description: An FDM printed sample is made so the customer can hold the part and approve the shape before the mould is cut.

steps.name: Mould manufacturing
steps.description: Core and cavity are machined on the VMC, detailed on the EDM, then fitted and polished by hand.

steps.name: Mould trial
steps.description: The mould is loaded on the injection moulding machine and trialled. Shot weight, cycle and cooling are set until the part comes out right.

steps.name: Production
steps.description: Once approved, the mould runs in production. Parts are checked during the run, not only at the end.

steps.name: Final product
steps.description: Finished parts are inspected, counted, packed and dispatched.
